FeinwerkDataExploration.AvgTimeOnSiteOfTheseVisits: Avg. time on website of these visits
FeinwerkDataExploration.ActionsPerVisitOfTheseVisits: Actions per visit of these visits
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorInvalidDefinition: The exploration definition could not be read. Please send it as JSON.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorDimensionCount: Please choose one or two dimensions.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorUnknownDimension: The dimension %s is not available for this website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorMetricCount: Please choose between one and %s metrics.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorGoal: The goal ID must be a positive whole number.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSort: Please sort by one of the selected metrics or dimensions, in ascending or descending order.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorLimit: The number of rows must be between 1 and %s.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTimeout: The exploration took longer than %s seconds and was stopped to protect Matomo. Please choose a shorter period, add a segment, or use a visit dimension instead of pages or events. If this happens often, please ask your Matomo administrator about the time limit.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorPeriodNotSupported: Please choose a single day, week, month or date range.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorPeriodTooLong: An exploration covers at most %s days. Please choose a shorter period.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTooManyVisits: This period has more than %s visits, more than an exploration reads at once. Please choose a shorter period. Your Matomo administrator can change this threshold.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorBusy: Other explorations are running right now. Please try again in a moment.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorFilter: Filter %s is not valid. A text filter needs a dimension and a text of up to 1,000 characters, a number filter needs one of the selected metrics and a number.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMaxDaysHelp: Explorations read raw data, so long periods cost database time. An exploration covers up to 31 days.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingTimeoutSeconds: Time limit per query in seconds
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingTimeoutSecondsHelp: A query that takes longer is stopped, and the user is asked to choose a shorter period or a segment.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMaxVisits: Most visits in the chosen period
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMaxVisitsHelp: Above this number an exploration does not run, and the user is asked to choose a shorter period.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingUseReaderHelp: When a read database is configured in config.ini.php ([database_reader]), explorations run there.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMinimumRoleHelp: The lowest role a user needs on a website. Anonymous users can never use explorations.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSettingRange: Please enter a whole number between %1$s and %2$s.
FeinwerkDataExploration.FreeFormTableHelp: Combine any dimension with an optional second dimension and up to five metrics. The table is calculated from the raw data of the chosen period, so it is available at once and needs no archiving.
FeinwerkDataExploration.LimitReached: The row limit is reached. Raise the limit or add a filter to see further rows.
FeinwerkDataExploration.RawDataWarning: Raw data before %s has been deleted. The table only covers the days from that date on.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ReasonNoCommonActions: has no actions in common with the other dimension
FeinwerkDataExploration.ReasonMetricNeverMatches: is always 0 with the chosen dimensions
FeinwerkDataExploration.ReasonAlreadyChosen: already chosen as the other dimension
FeinwerkDataExploration.ChartNeedsRows: A chart needs at least two rows.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ChartOmittedRows: The chart shows the %s largest rows.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ChartOmittedSeries: The chart shows the %1$s largest values of %2$s.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ChartIncomplete: The result reached the row limit: points outside it are missing in the chart. Raise the limit for a complete chart.
FeinwerkDataExploration.LargePeriodHint: This period has about %1$s visits. Explorations with pages, events or other actions read many more rows than visits and can take a while or stop at the time limit of %2$s seconds. A shorter period or a segment makes them faster.
FeinwerkDataExploration.LargePeriodHintNoLimit: This period has about %s visits. Explorations with pages, events or other actions read many more rows than visits and can take a while. A shorter period or a segment makes them faster.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SlowQueryHint: This exploration took %1$s seconds (time limit %2$s seconds). It gets faster with a shorter period, a segment, or a visit dimension instead of pages or events. Results are kept for an hour, for five minutes while today is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SlowQueryHintNoLimit: This exploration took %s seconds. It gets faster with a shorter period, a segment, or a visit dimension instead of pages or events. Results are kept for an hour, for five minutes while today is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorRollUp: Explorations need the raw data of a website. A roll-up has none of its own: please choose one of its websites.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTimeoutSuperUser: The exploration took longer than %s seconds and was stopped to protect Matomo. Please choose a shorter period, add a segment, or use a visit dimension instead of pages or events. As a super user you can raise the time limit in the plugin settings or let explorations run on a read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTooManyVisitsSuperUser: This period has more than %s visits, more than an exploration reads at once. Please choose a shorter period. As a super user you can change this threshold in the plugin settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionConversions: The number of conversions in these visits, of all goals or of the chosen goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionRevenue: The revenue of the conversions in these visits, of all goals or of the chosen goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionDownloads: The number of times a file was downloaded.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionOutlinks: The number of clicks on links to other websites.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricNoteUniqueVisitors: Explorations count them exactly over the whole period, also for weeks and months.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ShowFromFirstCompleteDay: Show the period from this day
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingsLimitsIntro: Limits: explorations read raw data. Higher values let them read more and put more load on your database; 31 days and 1,000 rows are the maximum.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingUseReaderNoReaderHelp: No read replica is configured ([database_reader] in config.ini.php), so explorations run on the main database. Once one is configured, they use it when this is on.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SmallerPeriodNone: Even a single day of this period has more visits than an exploration reads at once. Your Matomo administrator can raise this threshold.
FeinwerkDataExploration.RowBreakDown: Break down by a second dimension
FeinwerkDataExploration.VisitsLogDisabled: The visits log is turned off for this website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.NoVisitsForRow: This row has no segment (date, weekday, hour or an unknown value).
FeinwerkDataExploration.ExploreRowHelp: Opens an exploration on the visits of this row, to break them down by a second dimension.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticReplica: Explorations run on the read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticNoReplica: No read replica is configured ([database_reader] in config.ini.php), so explorations run on the main database. On large instances a read replica keeps them away from tracking and archiving.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticReplicaOff: The plugin settings let explorations run on the main database, not on a read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticTimeLimit: The database stops an exploration after %s seconds.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticNoTimeLimit: The database cannot stop long queries (MySQL 5.7.8 or MariaDB 10.1 and newer can). Explorations are then only limited by the number of visits per period; consider a lower threshold.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticRawDataDeleted: Raw data older than %s days is deleted regularly; explorations cover the days after that.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticRawDataKept: Raw data is kept; explorations can cover any period of up to the longest period in the settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticLimits: Limits: %1$s days per exploration, %2$s rows, %3$s visits per period, %4$s explorations at the same time.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SmallerPeriodNoneSuperUser: Even a single day of this period has more visits than an exploration reads at once. As a super user you can raise this threshold in the plugin settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.NoFilterForRow: This row stands for visits without a value or a value longer than 1,000 characters, a filter cannot select it.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSavedNotFound: This saved exploration does not exist (any more) on this website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSavedNotYours: Only the person who saved this exploration or a super user can change or delete it. Save it as your own instead.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSavedName: Please give the exploration a name of up to %s characters.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSavedState: This exploration cannot be saved: its settings are not valid.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSavedLimit: You have saved %s explorations on this website, the most there can be. Please delete one first.
FeinwerkDataExploration.VisibilityShared: Everyone who may use explorations on this website
FeinwerkDataExploration.SavedNotYours: Shared by %s. Save it as your own to change it.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MaxActionsOfTheseVisits: Maximum actions in one of these visits
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionAvgEventValue: The sum of the event values divided by the number of events that have a value.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionSearches: The number of searches in the website's site search.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionMaxActions: The highest number of actions in a single visit.
